description: Estimate what a American Airlines ticket earns (miles or points, and status credit where it applies), using cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

card.description: Paying with an AAdvantage card. none = No; MU = MileUp (+2 per $1); PS = Platinum Select (+2 per $1); GB = Globe (+3 per $1); EX = Executive (+4 per $1).

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of American Airlines's own: alaska = Atmos Rewards (creditStatus one of: Atmos Rewards member, Atmos Silver, Atmos Gold, Atmos Platinum, Atmos Titanium). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles). No price is needed with creditTo.

fare.description: Fare type. 1 = Standard (Main Cabin and above); 0 = Basic Economy.

price.description: Ticket price in US dollars. Base fare plus carrier-imposed fees, without government taxes. Required unless creditTo is given.

status.description: Your AAdvantage status. none = None; GL = Gold (+40%); PL = Platinum (+60%); PP = Platinum Pro (+80%); EP = Executive Platinum (+120%).

name: calculate_american_miles
title: American AAdvantage Calculator
